verification_method: All 23 internal events independently re-derived from data/catalog/youtube_channel_registry.db (videos table, ordered by published_at per canonical_channel_id) on 2026-09-25 and confirmed exact view-count match against the prose report. External events (5) have no registry entry — those channels were not acquired — and are sourced from live browser research (EXTERNAL-BREAKOUT-RESEARCH-RAW.md); 4 of 5 external video IDs were captured, 1 (SeniorHood breakout #1, 199K) was not.
correction_note: Supersedes the prior claim of '29 breakout events (23 internal + 6 external)' stated in SMALL-CHANNEL-BREAKOUT-FORENSICS.md, SENIOR-HEALTH-FORENSIC-REPORT-V3.md, FINAL-STATUS-V3.md and workbook sheets 00_READ_ME/39_V3_BREAKOUT_INVENTORY. Direct recount of the per-case data in the same source document sums to 23 internal + 5 external = 28, not 29/6. The underlying per-event row data in workbook sheet 39_V3_BREAKOUT_INVENTORY was already correct (28 data rows); only the prose summary count was wrong. See STAGE2-CORRECTION-LEDGER.md, correction NC-05. On 2026-09-25, 9 further internal events were added from Better Health While Aging (DS-000033), a newly acquired channel not present at the time of the NC-05 correction; internal_count is now 32 and canonical_event_count is now 37. 2026-09-25 addendum (Case 13 deep-dive): a supplementary local-baseline (time-matched, +/-20 videos) multiple was added to BE-29..BE-37 to address the concern that a single whole-catalog median can misrepresent a breakout's true local significance on a channel whose overall view level changed substantially over its multi-year history; it does not change the canonical event count or qualification rule, which remains whole-channel-median-based for cross-case comparability.

events.qualification_rule: external: informal visual outlier vs. double/triple-digit neighboring uploads (no channel median computed — disclosed gap, not a fixed threshold)
external: informal visual outlier (video_id not captured in raw research pass — title/view-count only)

events.local_baseline_method: median of +/-20 chronologically-nearest videos (regular+shorts), same channel
events.local_baseline_note: Added 2026-09-25 during Case 13 deep-dive: the flat whole-catalog median (21,647.5) mixes 2021 videos against a channel baseline that grew ~4x by 2025. Local baseline reveals the 3 earliest breakouts (2021) are UNDERSTATED by the flat median (up to 460.6x locally vs 165.5x documented); 2 of the 3 2025 entries (8_depH-gT4o, OCWvaUcSPOU) fall below the 15x corpus threshold against a contemporaneous baseline (10.4x, 10.2x) though remain real local outliers, not baseline noise.
